title: Four Tests to Know It’s God
hook: Is that God, or just me?
script: Is that God, or just me? When you face a door and don’t know to walk or wait, run what you’re sensing through four tests. Test 1: Does it align with Scripture? God won’t contradict His word (2 Tim 3:16). Test 2: Does it lead to Christlike character and fruit—love, joy, self-control (Gal 5:22–23)? Test 3: Do mature believers confirm it with humble unity (Prov 11:14)? Test 4: Do you sense peace with clear conviction, not panic or confusion (Col 3:15; 1 Cor 14:33)? If it passes, take the next faithful step. If not, pause and pray. My sheep hear My voice—Jesus (John 10:27).

title: When God Feels Silent: A 60-Second Reset
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: If God feels silent right now, watch this. Jesus said, My sheep hear My voice (John 10:27). Start by slowing your mind: breathe deep and sit in sixty seconds of quiet. Then open your Bible and read until a line grips you. Finally, write what you sense and weigh it with God’s filters: Scripture alignment (2 Tim 3:16), Christlike fruit (Gal 5:22–23), wise counsel (Prov 11:14), and peace with conviction, not chaos (Col 3:15; 1 Cor 14:33). Don’t rush the answer. Presence before plans. As you wait, obedience grows clearer, and anxiety shrinks. God isn’t hiding—He’s guiding.

title: Stop Overthinking: A 3-Day Hear-and-Do Plan
script: You may be overthinking this. We miss God’s voice when we chase signs without Scripture, or ignore the last clear nudge. Return to the Shepherd’s way. Day one: one minute of silence, then read John 10 and ask, Lord, what are You highlighting? Day two: write it down, test it with the Word (2 Tim 3:16) and Christlike fruit (Gal 5:22–23), and seek wise counsel for unity (Prov 11:14). Day three: take the smallest obedient step that carries peace with conviction, not confusion (Col 3:15; 1 Cor 14:33). Repeat this for three days. Clarity grows as you walk.
